programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels to Uttoxeter from Liverpool, beginning by learning about the design of the city's Metropolitan Cathedral of Christ the King, inaugurated in 1967. At Jodrell Bank, Michael hears how physicist Bernard Lovell's revolutionary research into meteors led to the construction of one of the biggest radio telescopes in the world

programme.title: Walking with Jim Moir
programme.desc: The comedian better known to some as Vic Reeves explores a fascinating corner of the Kent coast as he walks down to Dungeness. Along the way he meets locals, explores military ruins and rides a steam train

programme.title: The Treasures of Ancient Rome
programme.desc: Alastair Sooke explores the artistic achievements of the Romans, tracing their progression from thieves and copycats to pioneers of the use of unflinching realism. Portraits from the Republic reveal how they captured lifelike images and immortalised figures such as Julius Caesar and Cicero using marble, bronze and paint. Alastair also looks at how Rome's first emperor, Augustus, used art as a tool to forge his dominion

programme.title: Caligula with Mary Beard
programme.desc: Roman emperor Gaius Julius Caesar Augustus Germanicus - better known as Caligula - was said to have made his horse a consul, proclaimed himself a living God and indulged in scandalous orgies. In this documentary, classical scholar Mary Beard attempts to peel away some of the myths surrounding him, sifting through surviving evidence to paint a portrait of the real Caligula

programme.title: Sir Derek Jacobi Remembers - I, Claudius
programme.desc: The veteran actor looks back at the landmark 1976 drama, based on the novels of Robert Graves, telling the life story of a reluctant Roman emperor

programme.title: I, Claudius
programme.desc: Acclaimed drama set amidst a web of power, corruption and lies, chronicling the reigns of the Roman emperors - Augustus, Tiberius, Caligula and finally Claudius - focusing on the intrigue that surrounded their respective reigns. Augustus's wife Livia schemes to ensure her son Tiberius succeeds her husband. The dispute between Marcus Agrippa and Marcellus reaches boiling point, prompting the former to leave Rome for the East. With Derek Jacobi, Sian Phillips, Brian Blessed and George Baker

programme.title: I, Claudius

programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: It's an important year for the city of Hull, in northern England. It's celebrating more than 800 years of maritime history with a raft of new museum openings that it's hoped will make it a world-class visitor attraction. Emeline Nsingi Nkosi goes to see the opening of the restored Spurn Lightship - literally a lighthouse on a ship - which was a mainstay on the waterways there for 50 years. She meets the people involved in the huge regeneration effort and finds out why the city's been the punchline of jokes for so many years.

programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: Scotland's Greatest Escape
programme.desc: Father and daughter Graham and Aimee from Dumfriesshire try out three well-being retreats, visiting the elegant Stobo spa, having a close encounter at Sheepy Sleepovers and a staying in a handcrafted Romani caravan at Roulotte Retreat. JJ Chalmers and Grado present

programme.title: Paramedics on Scene
programme.desc: Crews are mobilised to a large building fire in Glasgow city centre, with concerns that people are trapped inside. As fire and rescue battle the blaze, Stewart of the Paramedic Response Unit endures heavy rain and prepares to treat casualties. Meanwhile, Ayr-based crew Sophie and Shelby treat a man who has been drinking alcohol and has sustained a concerning head injury, but is adamant he doesn't want to go to hospital.

programme.title: Ooh the Banter
programme.desc: Jack Docherty delves into the BBC archives for a celebration of Scottish comedy, joined by Elaine C Smith, Alex Norton, Karen Dunbar, Lawrence Chaney, Brian Cox, Alan Cumming and Forbes Masson. Jack draws a line from the early days of Scottish comedy on TV from the McFlannels, Stanley Baxter and Lex McLean through to the modern generation of quickfire online sensations, and finds that colourful language, authenticity, irreverence and flair for creative insults remain the cornerstones of Scottish humour

programme.title: Still Game
programme.desc: Jack and Victor worry that Bert has been suffering since his wife died, while Winston has acquired a limp and a home help. Comedy, starring Ford Kiernan and Greg Hemphill

programme.title: Two Doors Down
programme.desc: Over at Beth and Eric's, the neighbours are getting stuck into a family sized box of doughnuts when the new health-conscious residents, Ash and Iqbal, turn up to introduce themselves. Comedy, starring Arabella Weir and Alex Norton

programme.title: Rip It Up
programme.desc: Examining Scotland's unique pop music history, beginning with performers revealing how they went from bedroom dreamers to international superstars. Featuring contributions from solo artists like Lulu and Donovan, as well as members of pioneering groups including the Skids, Nazareth, the Incredible String Band, Josef K, the Average White Band, Middle of the Road, the Rezillos, the Beatstalkers and the Sensational Alex Harvey Band.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: On Papa Westray, Paul's visiting nephews are roped into farm work, while Paul and Mel have lots to do for their long-awaited wedding day. It's a concerning time for Sally as some of her ewes are struck down by a devastating mystery illness. In Fife, Andy and Jo increase their loan to install another holiday pod and take 400 lambs to market to raise some much-needed cash

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Brian Cunningham and Kirsty Wilson work on the garden's borders, replanting, filling gaps and replacing losses all around the plot. Kirsty will also be planting in the border behind Beechgrove's main pond, where other gaps have appeared, and she is building a new structure to create a habitat for pollinators

programme.title: Paramedics on Scene
programme.desc: In Ayr, crewmates Sophie and Shelby are called to a critical incident in which Irene has suffered a burst gastric ulcer and is losing pints of blood. Meanwhile, Aberdeen-based paramedic Andrew, technician Simon and student Matthew treat Patrick, who is displaying a range of worrying symptoms, including a worsening headache, a rash and a sensitivity to light. The team can't rule out meningitis, but encounter a queue of ambulances outside Aberdeen Royal Infirmary

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: Scotland's Home of the Year 2024
programme.desc: Judges Anna Campbell-Jones, Banjo Beale and Danny Campbell visit properties in central Scotland. The first home for the judges to visit is the Old Mill near Dunblane, an empty industrial building converted a five-bedroom home. Next up is Sandstone Villa in Bridge of Allan, a semi-deteched property which dates back to the early 1900s. Finally, the judges visit Courtyard Farmhouse, a conversion of a once-derelict farmhouse between Falkirk and Linlithgow

programme.title: Island Crossings
programme.desc: Area operations manager Fiona Galbraith travels to Stornoway from her home on Benbecula to help out with a freight backlog and keep the essential supply lines open between the mainland and the Outer Hebrides. Sisters Natalie and Tanya Mackay from the Isle of Lewis are now a couple of weeks into their modern apprenticeship with CalMac and are about to join a vessel for the first time

programme.title: Mhairi Black: Being Me Again
programme.desc: The ex-SNP MP talks about her life in depth. As well as interviews with her wife Katie, and father Alan, cameras gain access at the House of Commons, and the first night of her stand-up show, Politics Isn't for Me, at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe. Mhairi, the youngest person elected to the House of Commons, also discusses feelings about her own neurodivergence

programme.title: River City
programme.desc: Roisin is at her wits end when she reaches breaking point over Gillian's behaviour and Jodie drops a bombshell. Chris is forced to face the music when he realises paying Nicole is impossible, Tyler struggles to get dirt on Alex, and Amber considers her next steps with Angus

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: After accidentally picking up one of Cathy's novels, Agnes discovers she has a surprising fondness for steamy fiction. She then gatecrashes the next group meeting of Cathy's book group to share her insights on the genre, - mortifying her daughter in the process. Comedy, co-written by and starring Brendan O'Carroll, with Jennifer Gibney

programme.title: David Wilson's Crime Files
programme.desc: The criminologist explores how if a killer wants to get away with murder, they must get rid of the evidence - in other words, their victim - and their attempts to do that

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: Scotland's Greatest Escape
programme.desc: Fifer Mathew, his girlfriend Alexandra, little brother Malachi and mum Amanda from Fife visit a selection of getaways steeped in history, staying at a retreat with a military past, a 500-year-old castle and a former train station hotel. JJ Chalmers and Grado present

programme.title: Paramedics on Scene
programme.desc: In Glasgow, Paul and Ryan of the Special Operations Response Team are called to a siege in a flat, where a man has barricaded himself inside and is threatening to harm himself. Meanwhile, Aberdeen-based crewmates Kirsty and Bruce are called to see Rebecca, who has suffered a severe anaphylactic attack, but she shows little sign of improvement after several doses of adrenaline, prompting a rapid journey on blue-lights to Aberdeen Royal Infirmary

programme.title: Rikki
programme.desc: Ashley Jensen narrates a programme celebrating the life, career and legacy of Rikki Fulton, one of Scotland's most beloved comic actors and undisputed King of Hogmanay. This film tells the story of his extraordinary life by bringing together the people closest to him and the people he inspired, with never-before-seen home movie footage and clips of the best-loved moments of his career

programme.title: Still Game
programme.desc: Jack and Victor start to feel their age, but a new wonder drug promises to unlock the secret of eternal youth for the doughty pensioners. Comedy, starring Ford Kiernan and Greg Hemphill

programme.title: Two Doors Down
programme.desc: Cathy and Colin are back from an Italian holiday and excited to be hosting a soiree at their house - arranged for the purpose of showing off how popular they are. They invite Gail and Andy, who they met in Sorrento, but as the duty-free wine flows and the guests of honour begin to bond a bit too much with the neighbours, Cathy and Colin's tensions soon bubble to the surface

programme.title: Rip It Up
programme.desc: A look at how Scotland experienced a pop resurgence in the 1980s as bands such as Wet Wet Wet, Deacon Blue, Texas and the Proclaimers began to hit the charts. Contributors include Jim Kerr, Alan Rankine, Emma Pollock Martin Bulloch, Stuart Braithwaite, Dougie Vipond, Ricky Ross, Charlie and Craig Reid, Sharleen Spiteri , KT Tunstall, Duglas Stewart, Sean Dickson and Alan McGee

programme.title: The Catch Up
programme.desc: A round-up of the day's news

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall takes a helicopter trip over Brazil's northern savannah in search of the giant anteater and encounters an unusual owl

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall continues his journey in the rainforests of Brazil, where he searches for piranha and encounters one of the most venomous snakes in the world

programme.title: Horrible Histories: The Movie
programme.desc: Atti, a smart and quick-witted Roman teenager, manages to upset Emperor Nero with one of his schemes. For punishment, Atti is sent to work in a cold and wet Britain, where he also meets the Celts. Family comedy, starring Sebastian Croft and Craig Roberts

programme.title: Ludwig
programme.desc: While investigating the suspicious death of a headmaster, John faces his bad school memories but is pleasantly surprised when he reconnects with his old mentor. Lucy follows a new lead in her search for James as her covert mission takes her to Wales

programme.title: Fleabag
programme.desc: First episode of the comedy, written by and starring Phoebe Waller-Bridge, based on her one-woman stage show about a woman wrestling with the demands of modern living through a mixture of bravado and casual sex. Fleabag struggles to make ends meet in the frenetic world of contemporary London as she tries to work out what she should be doing with her life. With Olivia Colman and Hugh Dennis

programme.title: Fleabag
programme.desc: Haunted by memories of her dead best friend, dumped by her emotionally fragile boyfriend, and now desperately trying to sell her stolen goods, Fleabag attempts to rekindle romantic fires to distract her from the mayhem of her life. Comedy, written by and starring Phoebe Waller-Bridge

programme.title: Fleabag
programme.desc: Claire organises a surprise birthday party for herself. Fleabag helps her 'inappropriate' brother-in-law to shop for the perfect present, and runs into an old friend while trying to find a date. Award-winning comedy, written by and starring Phoebe Waller-Bridge

programme.title: Fleabag
programme.desc: Claire takes Fleabag to an all-female silent retreat. What should be a period of peaceful solitude is disrupted by some explosive secrets coming to light, a surprising connection with an old acquaintance, and an unusual neighbouring workshop. Comedy, written by and starring Phoebe Waller-Bridge

programme.title: Fleabag
programme.desc: Claire and Fleabag return to their father's home for an annual family gathering to mark the anniversary of their mother's death - but this time there is an unwanted guest. Fleabag gets into a confrontation with her godmother, who reveals her plans for a sexually charged art exhibition. Comedy, written by and starring Phoebe Waller-Bridge

programme.title: Fleabag
programme.desc: Surprises are in store when Fleabag attends her godmother's exhibition of erotic art, having managed to acquire a date for the occasion. She finds herself confronted with a declaration of love and a very familiar piece of work, but Claire is notable by her absence. The awkward artistic gathering forces Fleabag to face up to the consequences of her actions - as well as finally revealing what happened to her best friend Boo. Conclusion of the comedy series, written by and starring Phoebe Waller-Bridge

programme.title: Ideal
programme.desc: Moz takes an interest in his new neighbour, while Nicki worries about the identity of her baby's father. Derrick and Yasuko are getting married, so Cartoon Head organises a stag night that degenerates into a full-blown riot. Comedy, starring Johnny Vegas

programme.title: Ideal
programme.desc: Moz wakes up next to someone unexpected, before finding 200 pairs of shoes in his living room and accidentally filling his kitchen with foam. The day goes from bad to worse when his landlord announces he's paying a visit. Comedy, starring Johnny Vegas

programme.title: Ideal
programme.desc: Moz wrestles with his confused feelings for Judith, but soon has other problems to contend with. PC impounds a crop of marijuana plants and needs somewhere to hide them, while suspicions arise that the deceased Craig's ghost is haunting the flat. Comedy, starring Johnny Vegas

programme.title: Ideal
programme.desc: Elderly neighbour Mrs Coneybear is disturbed by strange noises and decides to hold a seance. Moz is concerned about keeping his marijuana plants a secret, Steve discovers what happened to his brother and Judith makes a surprising confession. Johnny Vegas stars

programme.title: Ideal
programme.desc: Cartoon Head and Psycho Paul pressure Moz into helping them carry out a kidnapping, but he refuses - until the mouse-masked hit-man's infamous boss Stemroach pays him a visit. A policeman gets trapped in the loft, threatening not only the abduction but also the drug dealer's own business

programme.title: Funboys
programme.desc: Two emotionally unassembled young men start a play group, Funboys Fun Club, for childish young men to engage in some wholesome mucking about. When they come across severely depressed 60-year-old Marty, they try their best to bring some joy back to his life. Pilot for the sitcom, with Rian Lennon and Ryan Early

programme.title: The Catch Up
programme.desc: A round-up of the day's news

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall presents some of his favourite moments from the wildlife series, including abseiling into the Gomantong cave system and meeting a hippo

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall and his team show how they coped with filming in temperatures below minus 20 in the frozen tundra of Alaska and in the humidity and heat of the unforgiving rainforests of Brazil in order to capture the wildlife that call these places home

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May try to make train travel cheaper, faster and more interesting, replacing the locomotive with a specially modified car and the carriages with a series of caravans. Comedy star Rowan Atkinson gets behind the wheel of the Reasonably Priced Car and Jeremy drives the Jaguar XKR-S and a Nissan GT-R round the track to compare both models

programme.title: I Am Legend
programme.desc: A Manhattan-based military scientist finds himself immune to a virus that turns humans into ferocious vampire-like creatures. After the disease has swept across the world, wiping out an estimated 90 per cent of the human population, he devotes his solitary existence to finding a cure by unlocking the secret within his blood. Sci-fi thriller, starring Will Smith, Alice Braga and Charlie Tahan

programme.title: Kidnapped by My Mum
programme.desc: Part one of two. The story of Alex Batty, who went missing when he was 11 on what was supposed to be a short family holiday with his mother and grandfather. Now aged 20, he tells the full story about his abduction and his life on the run, retracing the route of his disappearance across Spain and France, uncovering not just how he was hidden but the belief system that kept him there

programme.title: Stacey Dooley: Ready for War?
programme.desc: The reporter follows a group of Ukrainian civilians as they arrive in the UK for five weeks of intensive army training before deployment to the frontline fighting against Russia. Among the group is florist and gardener Mykola who wants to join his family members on the frontline and fight towards victory so he can marry his girlfriend. For Pasha, a welder who was living abroad when the invasion began, he fears going into battle means never seeing his parents again

programme.title: Roman Kemp: The Fight for Young Lives
programme.desc: Broadcaster Roman Kemp knows first-hand the impact of serious mental health issues. In 2020, he made Our Silent Emergency in the wake of the death of a friend. He encouraged those in need to talk to friends, family and professionals, but now strives to move the conversation on from talking about mental health to discovering what action is needed to support those suffering

programme.title: Hippos: Africa's River Giants

In Botswana's Okavango delta, hippos face an unparalleled challenge - deep floodwaters dry to dust in a matter of months. In one extraordinary season, cameras go beneath the surface to see them protect their families and face enemies as they deal with the drought. Going far beyond their dangerous reputation, the programme discovers the true nature of the hippo, an animal that is compassionate, sensitive and highly intelligent

programme.title: Live Tennis
programme.desc: The Washington DC Open. Coverage of day three of the WTA 500 and ATP 500 event, a hard-court tournament held at William H.G. FitzGerald Tennis Center in the USA. All three of the British players involved in the second round of last year's competition emerged victorious, with Emma Raducanu beating four-time Grand slam champion Naomi Osaka in straight sets, while Dan Evans triumphed 6-4 6-4 over Alex Michelsen, and Cameron Norrie beat the number two seed Lorenzo Musetti 3-6 6-2 6-3. Perhaps the most notable victory was claimed by 2021 US Open runner-up Leylah Fernandez, who eliminated the number one seed Jessica Pegula in a see-saw encounter that finished 6-3 1-6 7-5 in her favour

programme.desc: The Washington DC Open. Coverage of day three of the WTA 500 and ATP 500 event, a hard-court tournament held at William H.G. FitzGerald Tennis Center in the USA. All three of the British players involved in the second round of last year's competition emerged victorious, with Emma Raducanu beating four-time Grand slam champion Naomi Osaka in straight sets, while Dan Evans triumphed 6-4 6-4 over Alex Michelsen, and Cameron Norrie beat the number two seed Lorenzo Musetti 3-6 6-2 6-3. Perhaps the most notable victory was claimed by 2021 US Open runner-up Leylah Fernandez, who eliminated the number one seed Jessica Pegula in a see-saw encounter that finished 6-3 1-6 7-5 in her favour
